originalTitle: Why Akamai Technologies (AKAM) Dipped More Than Broader Market Today
summary: Akamai Technologies (AKAM) reached $106.35 at the closing of the latest trading day, reflecting a -1.94% change compared to its last close.
content:
In the latest trading session, Akamai Technologies (AKAM) closed at $106.35, marking a -1.94% move from the previous day. The stock trailed the S&P 500, which registered a daily loss of 0.25%. At the same time, the Dow lost 0.86%, and the tech-heavy Nasdaq gained 0.24%.

Coming into today, shares of the cloud services provider had gained 1.87% in the past month. In that same time, the Computer and Technology sector gained 4%, while the S&P 500 lost 0.42%.

Investors will be eagerly watching for the performance of Akamai Technologies in its upcoming earnings disclosure. The company is forecasted to report an EPS of $1.67, showcasing a 10.22% downward movement from the corresponding quarter of the prior year. Meanwhile, the Zacks Consensus Estimate for revenue is projecting net sales of $1.12 billion, up 6.07% from the year-ago period.

Regarding the entire year, the Zacks Consensus Estimates forecast earnings of $6.63 per share and revenue of $4.49 billion, indicating changes of -6.88% and +6.59%, respectively, compared to the previous year.

It's also important for investors to be aware of any recent modifications to analyst estimates for Akamai Technologies. These revisions typically reflect the latest short-term business trends, which can change frequently. With this in mind, we can consider positive estimate revisions a sign of optimism about the business outlook.

Our research suggests that these changes in estimates have a direct relationship with upcoming stock price performance. To take advantage of this, we've established the Zacks Rank, an exclusive model that considers these estimated changes and delivers an operational rating system.

The Zacks Rank system, which varies between #1 (Strong Buy) and #5 (Strong Sell), carries an impressive track record of exceeding expectations, confirmed by external audits, with stocks at #1 delivering an average annual return of +25% since 1988. Within the past 30 days, our consensus EPS projection has moved 1.67% lower. Akamai Technologies is currently a Zacks Rank #4 (Sell).

With respect to valuation, Akamai Technologies is currently being traded at a Forward P/E ratio of 16.35. This valuation marks a premium compared to its industry average Forward P/E of 15.48.

We can additionally observe that AKAM currently boasts a PEG ratio of 2.76. This popular metric is similar to the widely-known P/E ratio, with the difference being that the PEG ratio also takes into account the company's expected earnings growth rate. As the market closed yesterday, the Internet - Services industry was having an average PEG ratio of 1.68.

The Internet - Services industry is part of the Computer and Technology sector. This group has a Zacks Industry Rank of 200, putting it in the bottom 19% of all 250+ industries.

The Zacks Industry Rank gauges the strength of our industry groups by measuring the average Zacks Rank of the individual stocks within the groups. Our research shows that the top 50% rated industries outperform the bottom half by a factor of 2 to 1.

chineseTitle: 为什么 Akamai Technologies (AKAM) 的跌幅超过当今大盘
chineseSummary: Akamai Technologies (AKAM)在最近一个交易日收盘时达到106.35美元，较上一交易日收盘价上涨-1.94%。
chineseContent:
在最新的交易日中，Akamai Technologies (AKAM) 收于 106.35 美元，较前一交易日上涨 -1.94%。该股落后于标准普尔 500 指数，后者日跌幅为 0.25%。与此同时，道指下跌 0.86%，以科技股为主的纳斯达克指数上涨 0.24%。

截至今天，这家云服务提供商的股价在过去一个月上涨了 1.87%。与此同时，计算机和技术板块上涨 4%，而标准普尔 500 指数下跌 0.42%。

投资者将热切关注 Akamai Technologies 在即将披露的财报中的表现。该公司预计每股收益为 1.67 美元，较去年同期下降 10.22%。与此同时，Zacks 的收入共识预计净销售额为 11.2 亿美元，比去年同期增长 6.07%。

就全年而言，Zacks 一致预期每股收益为 6.63 美元，营收为 44.9 亿美元，与上年相比分别变化-6.88%和+6.59%。

对于投资者来说，了解 Akamai Technologies 分析师预测的最新修改也很重要。这些修订通常反映最新的短期业务趋势，这些趋势可能经常变化。考虑到这一点，我们可以将积极的估计修正视为对业务前景乐观的迹象。

我们的研究表明，这些预估变化与即将到来的股价表现有直接关系。为了利用这一点，我们建立了 Zacks Rank，这是一个独特的模型，考虑了这些估计的变化并提供了一个可操作的评级系统。

Zacks Rank 系统介于#1（强力买入）和#5（强力卖出）之间，具有超出预期的令人印象深刻的记录，经外部审计证实，自 1988 年以来，排名第一的股票的平均年回报率为 +25%。在过去 30 天内，我们的共识 EPS 预测下降了 1.67%。 Akamai Technologies 目前排名第四（销售）。

就估值而言，Akamai Technologies 目前的远期市盈率为 16.35。与行业平均远期市盈率 15.48 相比，这一估值存在溢价。

我们还可以观察到 AKAM 目前的 PEG 比率为 2.76。这个流行的指标与广为人知的市盈率类似，不同之处在于，PEG比率还考虑了公司的预期盈利增长率。截至昨天收盘，互联网服务行业的平均 PEG 率为 1.68。

互联网服务行业是计算机和技术行业的一部分。该群体的 Zacks 行业排名为 200，在所有 250 多个行业中排名垫底 19%。

Zacks 行业排名通过衡量行业组内个股的平均 Zacks 排名来衡量我们行业组的实力。我们的研究表明，排名前 50% 的行业的表现比排名后一半的行业高出 2 比 1。
